mapper.select: SELECT id, model_name, model_id, provider, api_url, max_context_tokens, status, remark, created_time FROM ai_model_config ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_config (model_name, model_id, provider, api_url, api_key_encrypted, max_context_tokens, status, remark, created_time) VALUES (#{modelName}, #{modelId}, #{provider}, #{apiUrl}, #{apiKeyEncrypted}, #{maxContextTokens}, 1, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_config SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
